Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

The present invention provides a soft polyurethane foam molded article (1) that has a mounting surface (1A) and is obtained by foam-molding a foaming stock solution. The soft polyurethane foam molded article (1) includes a plurality of layered parts (11 and 12) that form layers in a vertical direction (Y) perpendicular to the mounting surface. A plurality of foaming cells included in each of the layered parts have a ratio of a size in a lateral direction (X) along the mounting surface with respect to a size in the vertical direction that becomes larger as the foaming cells become positioned closer to the side of the mounting surface (1A) in the vertical direction. At boundaries (C1 and A2) between the layered parts adjacent to each other in the vertical direction, the ratio of a foaming cell included in the layered part (11) on the side of the mounting surface is lower than the ratio of a foaming cell included in the layered part (12) on the side of a back surface (1B) opposite to the side of the mounting surface.

outputs.L4:
The invention relates to a soft polyurethane foam article having a mounting surface and a thickness direction extending away from that surface. The article is formed by molding a polyurethane foaming stock solution so that the resulting foam structure is divided, in the thickness direction, into a plurality of vertically stacked layers. Each layer contains cells whose shapes vary according to their position relative to the mounting surface.

Within an individual layer, the cells become progressively wider in a direction parallel to the mounting surface as their position approaches the mounting surface. In other words, the ratio of a cell dimension parallel to the mounting surface to a cell dimension perpendicular to the mounting surface increases through the layer toward the mounting surface. This variation gives each layer a controlled gradient of cell anisotropy rather than a uniform cellular structure.

At the boundary between adjacent layers, the dimensional ratio does not continue increasing without interruption. Instead, the ratio decreases or resets to a lower value at the start of the next layer and then again increases toward the mounting-surface side of that layer. Repeating this pattern produces a multilayer foam in which each layer has its own anisotropy gradient.

The foam article may be manufactured by supplying and foaming the polyurethane stock solution in successive molding stages or under molding conditions that periodically alter cell growth. The timing and conditions of foaming are controlled so that the desired cell-orientation pattern is established in each layer while the layers remain integrated into a single soft foam body. The resulting article can therefore be produced without separately manufacturing and bonding multiple foam sheets.

By controlling the number and thickness of the layers, as well as the degree of change in cell dimensions within each layer, the mechanical response of the foam can be adjusted. The layered cell structure may provide selected combinations of softness, resilience, compressibility, load distribution, vibration absorption, and shape recovery. Accordingly, the foam article is suitable for applications such as cushioning, seating, bedding, pads, supports, and other products in which controlled deformation relative to a mounting surface is desirable.
outputs.L5:
### The Power of “The”

“The” is one of the smallest yet most important words in the English language. Known as the definite article, it identifies a specific person, place, object, or idea. For example, “a book” could mean any book, while “the book” refers to one particular book.

Although it often goes unnoticed, “the” brings clarity and precision to communication. It helps readers understand what is already known, unique, or especially relevant. From “the sun” to “the answer,” this simple word guides meaning in countless sentences.

Its quiet but constant presence shows that even the shortest words can play a powerful role in language.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract describing a molded soft polyurethane foam article with a mounting surface, vertically layered regions, and controlled foaming-cell aspect ratios that vary within and between the layers.
counterfactuals.output: A molded soft polyurethane foam article includes a mounting surface and a plurality of vertically layered foam regions arranged in a thickness direction relative to the mounting surface. Each foam region comprises foaming cells having a controlled aspect ratio defined by a cell dimension in a vertical direction divided by a cell dimension in a direction parallel to the mounting surface. The aspect ratios vary within at least one of the foam regions and differ between at least two vertically adjacent foam regions. In certain regions, the aspect ratio changes progressively, stepwise, or locally as a function of distance from the mounting surface. The layered cell morphology may be produced by controlling mold temperature, foaming pressure, reactive-mixture distribution, gas generation, or curing conditions during molding. The resulting article provides spatially tailored compressibility, resilience, load distribution, vibration attenuation, and shape recovery while retaining an integrally molded soft polyurethane foam structure.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write an English patent claim-style description for a soft polyurethane foam molded article whose cell width-to-height ratio increases toward the mounting surface within each layer but changes discontinuously at boundaries between adjacent layers.
counterfactuals.output:
1. A soft polyurethane foam molded article comprising:

a mounting surface; and

a plurality of foam layers arranged in a thickness direction relative to the mounting surface,

wherein each of the plurality of foam layers includes a plurality of cells, each cell having a width measured in a direction parallel to the mounting surface and a height measured in the thickness direction,

counterfactuals.prompt: Convert the following technical concept into patent language: a foam-molded polyurethane component has multiple layers perpendicular to its mounting face, anisotropic cells, and a repeating cell-aspect-ratio gradient across each layer.
counterfactuals.output:
**Patent-style claim language:**

1. A foam-molded polyurethane component comprising:  
a mounting face; and  
a cellular body comprising a plurality of layers arranged successively in a direction substantially perpendicular to the mounting face, each layer including anisotropic cells having respective cell aspect ratios, wherein the cell aspect ratios vary according to a predetermined gradient across each layer, and wherein the gradient is repeated in the plurality of layers.

**Alternative specification language:**

The foam-molded polyurethane component includes a multilayer cellular structure extending generally normal to a mounting face of the component. The cellular structure comprises anisotropic cells whose aspect ratios vary spatially across each layer according to a recurring gradient profile, such that the gradient profile is repeated from layer to layer.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4
